paraphrase: Do not recall (the past), do not imagine (the future), do not think (in the present), do not examine, do not control (or meditate), rest (the mind) in its own place.
notes: Reference from memory; the text is not available locally. Widely quoted; the Tibetan (mi mno, mi bsam, mi dpyod, mi sgom, mi sems, rang sar bzhag) is recalled but not verified; renderings of each verb differ.
